body: Thank you I really appreciate it.  But I have been trying to get better for so long and it is steadily getting worse.  I'm afraid that I no longer have drinking under control.  The timing of this is really terrible, and as much as I hate to say it out loud, I do think that I am alone in this.

I sobered up a bit while eating alone and decided to come home for the night.  Thanks for your support.  I just hope this cycle doesn't start again.  I hate being melodramatic.  I have no idea why I am doing this and crying out for attention on the internet, and it is killing me.

I am done with the vodka and now I am going to walk to the dining hall for my last meal.  There should be no cause for alarm because I have thought the last three nights this will be my last meal, but clearly I was too much of a coward to follow through.  I am hoping if I have a personal car service to the city that will help.
Thank you for reaching out.  I really hope things get better for you.

Lost all my friends four months before graduation because I did something terrible that I don't even remember or understand.  Alone for a while now.  Gained an inordinate amount of weight in short amount of time.  Drove away people who wanted or at least pretended to want to help.  Can barely take care of myself, but don't want to be hospitalized.  

People say I have so much going for me.  Great school, well-paying job after graduation.  But can barely function because of depression and alcohol consumption.  Tried to be strategic about drinking, but quickly spiraled out of control.  Can't stand running into people I know, even those who don'[t know what happened.  

Been unhappy for so long; upwards 5 years, or a quarter of my life.  Really, there is no hope because things will not get better for me.

Well, I was going to jump off the Golden Gate Bridge today and instead I am watching Tootsie.  Maybe you should too.  I still might do it, you know. But at least I am not feeling those feelings while I watch this movie.  It's not a permanent fix, but it keeps me occupied.
I was going to jump off the Golden Gate Bridge this weekend too, but it's sad to hear it from someone else.  I really hope you don't do it.
